title: No More Quiet Cries

promotion_decision.reason: v1 selected after comparative listening as extraordinary

style: narrative hip-hop with organic soul-reggae pulse, faster rap verses, melodic chorus and controlled protective anger

performance.verses: faster pocket, crisp subdivisions, tighter breath control, harder consonant attacks
performance.chorus: same approved hook and perceived speed, open melodic delivery, group response
performance.final_lift: maximum projection with inspiring communal energy

chorus_locked_text: Mama, no more quiet cries in the hallway.
I was too young, but I carried the whole weight.
I hate the hands that made you hide your light.
Now every scar in your name turns the dark to sunrise.
Mama, if I rise, then you rise with me.
No more quiet cries — this is what we're gonna be.

mix_direction.processing: controlled compression, faster attack, moderate parallel density, subtle harmonic saturation, clear upper-mid presence
mix_direction.chorus: wider doubles and backing voices without masking the lead

editorial_guardrails: preserve the dignity of the mother
anger directed at abuse, silence, neglect, illness and the cycle
no graphic violence or revenge glorification
no invented diagnosis, dates, names or identifiable third parties
